gsCode.protectedContainers.markdownDescription: Container public IDs (e.g. `GTM-XXXXXXX`) where **Create Version** and **Publish** are blocked. Pull and Push still work. Keep this in your User settings, not in a shared repo.

gsCode.pushStrategy.markdownDescription: `bulk` sends all changes in one `workspaces.bulk_update` call (fast, recommended). `sequential` uses one API call per entity (slow under the 0.25 QPS quota, but reports per-entity errors).

gsCode.allowPublish.markdownDescription: Request the `tagmanager.publish` OAuth scope at sign-in and enable **Create Version and Publish**. Set to `false` and sign in again for a token that cannot publish at all.

gsCode.autoPull.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep mirrors current automatically: check GTM on an interval, when the window gets focus and when a mirror opens. A check is 2 API requests; the full pull only runs when something changed. Unpushed and unsaved local edits are never overwritten.

gsCode.autoPull.intervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds between background checks for GTM changes (minimum 15). The GTM API allows 25 requests per 100 seconds per Google Cloud project; at 60 s a check uses about 3.

gsCode.debug.browserUrl.markdownDescription: Attach the debugger to a Chromium-based browser that already runs with `--remote-debugging-port`, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:9222`. Empty: GS Code launches your installed Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium with its own profile.

gsCode.debug.browserPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Chromium-based browser to launch. Empty: the first one found.

gsCode.debug.sgtmHosts.markdownDescription: Hosts of your server-side GTM (e.g. `sgtm.example.com`), so every request to them is recorded as a server-container hit.

gsCode.debug.loaderPatterns.markdownDescription: URL patterns (with `*`) of a custom gtm.js loader (e.g. Stape's first-party loader). In workspace mode they are redirected to the draft workspace on googletagmanager.com.

gsCode.debug.dataLayerName.markdownDescription: Name of the page's data layer array, if it is not `dataLayer`.

gsCode.debug.tagStatus.markdownDescription: Read each tag's status per event by adding an `eventCallback` to dataLayer events (a site's own callback still runs). Turn off if a site's code is sensitive to it.

languageModelTools.name: gtm_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Local changes in the open GTM mirror that Push would send, with conflicts and validation problems. Returns an `expected` signature for gtm_push.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Local changes in the open GTM mirror that Push would send, with conflicts and validation problems. Returns an `expected` signature for gtm_push.

languageModelTools.name: gtm_pull
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Pull the latest workspace contents from GTM into the mirror (three-way merge; local edits are kept).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Pull the latest workspace contents from GTM into the mirror (three-way merge; local edits are kept).

languageModelTools.name: gtm_push
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Push the reviewed local changes to the GTM workspace (never live; agents cannot publish). Pass `expected` from gtm_status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Push the reviewed local changes to the GTM workspace (never live; agents cannot publish). Pass `expected` from gtm_status.

languageModelTools.name: debug_start
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a page in the GS Code debugger and record dataLayer events, tag status, consent and network hits. mode 'workspace' loads the unpublished workspace, 'live' the published container.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a page in the GS Code debugger and record dataLayer events, tag status, consent and network hits. mode 'workspace' loads the unpublished workspace, 'live' the published container.

tab.description: Use an already open tab whose URL starts with this (attached browsers only)

languageModelTools.name: debug_events
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recorded events of the latest page: sequence number, event name, tags fired, hits sent.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Recorded events of the latest page: sequence number, event name, tags fired, hits sent.

languageModelTools.name: debug_event
languageModelTools.modelDescription: One recorded event in detail: pushed data, data model, consent, tag statuses, hits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: One recorded event in detail: pushed data, data model, consent, tag statuses, hits.

languageModelTools.name: debug_explain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Why tags fired or did not fire on an event: triggers and conditions with compared values, and the mirror file to edit.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Why tags fired or did not fire on an event: triggers and conditions with compared values, and the mirror file to edit.

languageModelTools.name: debug_hits
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Network hits (GA4, Google Ads, Meta, server container…), filtered by vendor or event name.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Network hits (GA4, Google Ads, Meta, server container…), filtered by vendor or event name.

languageModelTools.name: debug_replay_sgtm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replay captured server-container requests with an X-Gtm-Server-Preview header (from sGTM preview, 'Send requests manually'), so they show up in that sGTM preview.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Replay captured server-container requests with an X-Gtm-Server-Preview header (from sGTM preview, 'Send requests manually'), so they show up in that sGTM preview.

name.description: Only hits for this event name

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate the debug tab to a URL.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate the debug tab to a URL.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Reload the debug tab (after pushing a fix).
